_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company dedicated to helping people live healthier lives and making the health system work better for everyone.' 'If we fail to estimate, price for and manage our medical costs in an effective manner, the profitability of our risk-based products and services could decline and could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and cash flows.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based benefits products comprise nearly 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

'Premium revenues from risk-based benefits products comprise nearly 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 40.67x; +115% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.31; conservative 2yr -27%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -15.7%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.0%/yr (FY15 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.0%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +23.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2015-06-19) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 40.67x (71.0% downside to Bear $34.92 / +1.7% upside to Bull $122.43) | Adj composite 2.33 vs market 3.64: gap -1.31 [OVERVALUED] | +115% above the EPP floor $56.02 (9x FY15E $6.22) | Conservative 2-yr case: -27.3% total (-13.7%/yr) | At 19.3x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $159.14 sits above the BULL case; revenue +12.8% YoY in Q1 2015, forward revenues +9.6% (FY15 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
